activity_summary: At two you went on for the third afternoon of this play in the week. Kemp added nothing. You did not tell him about the king. John said the reckoning after would be short.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Went on, and left the king out of it.

entities.name: John Heminges
entities.context: Kept the afternoon to the play already done.

entities.name: Will Kemp
entities.context: Added no line, and asked for a short reckoning.

quotes.speaker: john_heminges
quotes.text: The third time this week we are on at two.
